summary: A CRM migration with a fixed licence deadline is blocked by poor data quality, depends on one leaving expert, and has no agent training plan.

signals.observation: The cutover date has slipped twice.
signals.evidence: Cutover was planned for 1 March and has already moved twice.
A trial data load found that 12% of customer records fail validation.

signals.observation: Knowledge of the old system rests on one person who is leaving.
signals.evidence: The only database administrator who knows the old schema leaves in five weeks.
Agents haven't been trained yet, and the busy season starts in May.

signals.observation: The end date is fixed by a contract, not by readiness.
signals.evidence: The sponsor expects the old system off by the end of April to avoid another licence renewal.

things_to_watch: Whether the licence can be extended month by month.
How many failing records are duplicates that can be merged automatically.
